description: Database of global regional, national, and platform regulatory deadlines compiled from App Store Compliance Playbook records.

deadlines.law: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
deadlines.requirement: Article 4 AI Literacy. Providers and deployers must take measures to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy, proportionate to context. A written policy, induction, and log are pragmatic evidence, not a stated legal mandate.

deadlines.law: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
deadlines.requirement: Article 5 Prohibited Practices (ban on subliminal manipulation, child exploitation, social scoring, biometric trait categorization, etc.).

deadlines.law: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
deadlines.requirement: Article 50 Transparency Obligations (AI-interaction disclosure, synthetic content marking, and deepfake disclosure).

deadlines.law: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
deadlines.requirement: GPAI-model obligations, governance, and penalties (Articles 99 and 100).

deadlines.law: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (as amended by AI Omnibus, in force 27 July 2026)
deadlines.requirement: High-risk AI systems (Annex III) obligations, compliance checks, and governance requirements deferred by the AI Omnibus (in force 27 July 2026). Date set by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026, in force, not a proposal.

deadlines.law: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (as amended by AI Omnibus, in force 27 July 2026)
deadlines.requirement: High-risk AI systems embedded in physical products (Annex I machinery, toys, lifts, etc.) compliance deferred by the AI Omnibus (in force 27 July 2026). Date set by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026, in force, not a proposal.

deadlines.law: EU Digital Markets Act (DMA)
deadlines.requirement: External purchase links and alternative payments (com.apple.developer.storekit.external-purchase-link entitlement, custom link sheet, CTC 5% reporting).

deadlines.law: EU Digital Services Act (DSA)
deadlines.requirement: Trader status declaration and verification (D-U-N-S, phone, email publish, 2FA verified) or app removal from EU storefront.

deadlines.law: European Accessibility Act (EAA), Directive (EU) 2019/882
deadlines.requirement: Harmonised standard EN 301 549 Chapter 11 / WCAG 2.1 AA mobile accessibility compliance and published accessibility statement.

deadlines.law: EU Data Act, Regulation (EU) 2023/2854
deadlines.requirement: Core data access-by-design obligations when apps interact with connected products and wearables.

deadlines.law: EU Data Act, Regulation (EU) 2023/2854
deadlines.requirement: Access-by-design technical implementation for connected wearables and devices. This is the Article 3(1) access-by-design duty for connected products, not cloud switching. Switching charges fall to zero on 12 January 2027 under Article 29(1).

deadlines.law: Cyber Resilience Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/2847
deadlines.requirement: Active vulnerability reporting and security incident notification obligations.

deadlines.law: Cyber Resilience Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/2847
deadlines.requirement: Main security-by-design and vulnerability handling obligations.

deadlines.law: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), 16 CFR Part 312
deadlines.requirement: Amended COPPA Rule compliance (biometric identifiers added to PII, separate opt-in consent for third-party disclosure/targeted-ads, written retention policy, written info-security program). The section 312.11 carve-outs are earlier dates (90 days and six months after the 22 April 2025 publication) and bind FTC-approved COPPA Safe Harbor programs only, not app developers.

deadlines.law: FTC Health Breach Notification Rule, 16 CFR Part 318
deadlines.requirement: 2024 Final Rule compliance (unauthorized sharing of health/sensitive data with advertisers treated as breach, mandatory 60-day notice).

deadlines.law: Texas SB 2420 (App Store Accountability Act)
deadlines.requirement: Age assurance and verifiable parental consent for minors on downloads, purchases, and major updates, delete age data, request age category. Statutory effective date 1 January 2026. Preliminary injunctions of 23 December 2025 were stayed by the Fifth Circuit on 4 June 2026 and the Supreme Court declined to vacate the stay on 6 July 2026, so the law is in force while the merits appeal is pending.

deadlines.law: Utah SB 142 (App Store Accountability Act) as amended by HB 498 (2026)
deadlines.requirement: Request and receive age category from store, confirm parental consent for minor accounts, delete verification data. HB 498 (2026) moved every substantive duty to Beginning May 6, 2027, brought pre-installed apps into scope, repealed Division rulemaking, and replaced AG enforcement with a private right of action (1,000 dollars per violation minimum). The CCIA challenge was voluntarily dismissed on 21 April 2026.

deadlines.law: Louisiana HB 977 (2026), Act No. 185, R.S. 51:1771 to 1775 (App Store Accountability Act), replacing HB 570 (2025)
deadlines.requirement: Age category request, parental consent, re-request consent on major updates. Act 481 of 2025 (HB 570) never takes effect. HB 977 re-enacts the regime effective 1 July 2027. Apple's storefront still exposes the Louisiana age-range signal on its own schedule.

deadlines.law: Alabama HB 161 (App Store Accountability Act)
deadlines.requirement: App stores verify age category, link minors to a parent account, and obtain verifiable parental consent per download and in-app purchase. Effective 1 January 2027 per HB 161 Section 14 (enrolled text). Accounts in existence on 2 October 2026 must be age-verified with consent before 1 October 2027.

deadlines.law: California CPRA (CPPA 2026 Regulations)
deadlines.requirement: Honoring Global Privacy Control (GPC), privacy policy/notice at collection, opt-out of sale/sharing/profiling, and sensitive personal info limits.
deadlines.grace_period: automated decision-making from 2027-04-01; cybersecurity audits from 2028-04-01

deadlines.law: Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), 740 ILCS 14
deadlines.requirement: Written notice and release before collecting biometric identifiers, public retention schedule, destruction within 3 years, and no sale.

deadlines.law: UK Online Safety Act 2023
deadlines.requirement: Highly Effective Age Assurance methods (facial age estimation, open banking, credit-card checks) to protect children from harmful content.

deadlines.law: ICO Age Appropriate Design Code (Children's Code)
deadlines.requirement: High privacy by default, data minimisation, geolocation off, profiling off by default, and a mandatory DPIA.

deadlines.law: Online Safety Amendment (Social Media Minimum Age) Act 2024
deadlines.requirement: Stop under-16s holding accounts on social media via robust age assurance; ringfence and destroy age data.

deadlines.law: Digital ECA (Law 15,211/2025)
deadlines.requirement: Accepted age verification (document check, facial estimation, CPF check); self-declaration check-box is prohibited.

deadlines.law: Telecommunications Business Act
deadlines.requirement: Approved billing providers, 26% commission, com.apple.developer.storekit.external-purchase entitlement, South Korea-only binary, modal sheet, reporting.

deadlines.law: Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) 2023 / DPDP Rules 2025
deadlines.requirement: Verifiable parental consent through government-backed system (e.g. DigiLocker) for under-18s; behavioral tracking/targeted ads prohibited.

deadlines.law: IMDA Code of Practice for Online Safety for App Distribution Services
deadlines.requirement: App-store age assurance (screen and stop users under 18 from downloading age-inappropriate apps), age-assurance data destroyed. This is the age-assurance bite date. The Code of Practice for Online Safety for App Distribution Services itself commenced 31 March 2025.

deadlines.law: Mobile App Filing with the MIIT (ICP Extension)
deadlines.requirement: Mandatory Chinese MIIT app filing, local partner/entity, real-name, PIPL privacy, data localization, Banhao license for games.

deadlines.law: Apple App Store Review Guidelines (Guideline 2.3.6)
deadlines.requirement: Every app must answer the updated age-rating questionnaire (13+, 16+, 18+ tiers, UGC/ Livestream indicators) or be blocked from updates.

deadlines.law: Apple App Store Submission Requirements
deadlines.requirement: From 28 April 2026 apps uploaded to App Store Connect must be built with the iOS 26 and iPadOS 26 SDK or later (and the matching watchOS 26, tvOS 26, visionOS 26 SDKs). Apple states the requirement in SDK terms, not Xcode terms, and macOS is not in Apple's list. Age assurance features additionally require the iOS 26.2 SDK with Xcode 26.2 (17C52) or later.

deadlines.law: Apple App Store Region Age Requirements
deadlines.requirement: Blocks users in Brazil, Australia, and Singapore from downloading apps rated 18-plus unless age confirmed through reasonable methods.

deadlines.law: Google Play Billing Policy
deadlines.requirement: All new apps and updates must use Play Billing Library version 8 or later from 31 August 2026, with an extension available to 1 November 2026. This is a publishing gate, already-published v7 binaries keep transacting until the 2027 all-apps deadline.

deadlines.law: Google Play Target API Requirement
deadlines.requirement: New apps and updates must target API level 35 (Android 15) or higher, and existing target API 34+.

deadlines.law: Google Play Target API Requirement
deadlines.requirement: New apps and updates must target API level 36 (Android 16) or higher from 31 August 2026, with a Play Console extension request available to 1 November 2026. Wear OS and Android Automotive OS apps must target API 35 or higher, Android TV and Android XR apps API 34 or higher. Existing apps must target API 35 or higher to stay available to new users on newer devices.

deadlines.law: Android Developer Verification Policy
deadlines.requirement: Sideloading leg. from 30 September 2026 apps installed on certified devices in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand must be registered to a verified developer identity (Android Developer Console, USD 25 for full distribution, free limited-distribution accounts up to 20 devices, D-U-N-S for organizations). Global expansion is stated only as 2027 with no exact date published. The separate Play leg (register every Play package name in Play Console by 30 September 2026, global) is GOOGLE-PLAY-APP-PACKAGE-REGISTRATION.

deadlines.law: Google Play Photo and Video Permissions Policy
deadlines.requirement: Broad-access READ_MEDIA_IMAGES/READ_MEDIA_VIDEO restricted to broad-access apps; others must use Android Photo Picker.

deadlines.law: Google Play Child Safety Standards Policy
deadlines.requirement: Publish CSAE standards on globally reachable web page, in-app feedback, CSAM response protocol, named child-safety contact.

deadlines.law: e-Evidence Package, Regulation (EU) 2023/1543
deadlines.requirement: Cross-border law enforcement direct electronic evidence access (10 days response timeline, and a critical 8-hour emergency timeline).

deadlines.law: Distance Marketing of Financial Services, Directive (EU) 2023/2673
deadlines.requirement: Prominent, easily accessible 'withdrawal button' or 'withdrawal function' on the online interface (including apps) to withdraw from contracts.

deadlines.law: General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR), Regulation (EU) 2023/988
deadlines.requirement: Display manufacturer identity, electronic and postal contact details, and product safety warnings on the online interface for consumer products.

deadlines.law: Google Play chargeback cost responsibility update (Play Console Help answer 17068375)
deadlines.requirement: For orders placed after 3 August 2026 the developer bears the purchase price less the service fee plus the financial institution's chargeback fee. Google Play covers only its service fee. Handle PendingRefundReviewNotification and call the Review Refund API within 24 hours to contest illegitimate disputes.

deadlines.law: Play Console requirements. organization registration for financial, health, VPN, and government apps (Play Console Help answers 10788890 and 17125096)
deadlines.requirement: Apps offering financial products (banking, loans, stock trading, investment funds, crypto wallets and exchanges), health apps (medical, human subjects research), apps approved to use the VpnService class, and government apps must be published from an organization account with a D-U-N-S number consistent with the Dun and Bradstreet profile. Non-compliant apps are removed.

deadlines.law: Android developer verification, Play leg. register every Play app package name in Play Console (Play Console Help answers 17125096 and 17134731)
deadlines.requirement: Register your app package names via Play Console to comply with Android developer verification. This leg is global and separate from the Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand sideloading leg. Non-registration risks global removal from Google Play.

deadlines.law: US alternative billing and external links program. transaction reporting and service fees (Play Console Help answer 16497028)
deadlines.requirement: Developers enrolled in the US alternative billing or external links program must report transactions and successful downloads and pay the relevant Play service fee starting 1 October 2026.

deadlines.law: Play Catalog Access Program (Play Console Help answers 17117200 and 15582165)
deadlines.requirement: From 22 July 2026 registered third-party US Android app stores can access the Play catalog and list your app by default. Opt out in Play Console under Settings, Catalog Settings, if you do not want distribution through third-party stores.

deadlines.law: Contacts Permissions, Location Permissions, and Foreground Service policy changes for apps targeting Android 17, API level 37 (Play Console Help answers 16909972 and 16965181)
deadlines.requirement: Apps targeting API 37 or later may request READ_CONTACTS only when the Android Contact Picker is insufficient for core functionality (declaration required), must implement the Android location button with the onlyForLocationButton manifest flag for location-button scope, and may no longer use a foreground service for geofencing (use the Geofence API). Pre-review checks flag contacts and location issues in Play Console from 27 October 2026.

deadlines.law: Play Console technical quality requirements. memory, bitmap, and DEX optimization thresholds (Play Console Help answer 17492799)
deadlines.requirement: Google states From February 2027 (exact day not published) apps must meet minimum optimization of at least 25 percent coverage across optimization, shrinking, and obfuscation with a tool such as R8, must not hold bitmaps in memory in non-visible states, and must stay within memory bad-behavior thresholds. Failure affects visibility and publishing capabilities.

deadlines.law: Play Console technical quality requirements. Zero-Tap Sign-In restoration (Play Console Help answer 17492799)
deadlines.requirement: Google states From April 2027 (exact day not published) any app supporting user sign-in, optional or mandatory, must restore the user's sign-in state when they move to a new Android device using the Restore Credentials API. Games are currently out of scope.

deadlines.law: Age-Restricted Content, Families, and Child Safety Standards policy expansion to anonymous and random chat apps (Play Console Help answers 17036597, 17122218, 14747720)
deadlines.requirement: Apps whose core function is random or anonymous chat with strangers must use Play Console tools to block minors, may not target children under Families, and are in scope of the Child Safety Standards policy (published CSAE standards, in-app reporting, CSAM removal, child-safety contact).

deadlines.law: App Store Connect social media capability declaration (Apple Developer news 0d2gpmml and tlur8uvi)
deadlines.requirement: Apple states Starting September 2026 (no exact day published) you must indicate whether your app or game includes social media capabilities to submit a new version or update, or to notarize for alternative marketplaces. Declaring social media places the app in the Time Allowance category for Social Media with a minimum 13+ rating, and the Declared Age Range API is required to serve under-13 users.
deadlines.affected_repository_sections: docs/APPLE.md Section 2 and the 2026 changes list, references/rules/metadata.md

deadlines.law: Apple EU business terms update. Core Technology Commission replaces the Core Technology Fee, ADPLA Attachment 14 (Apple Developer news gmws0jgp and 0cgo95n6)
deadlines.requirement: From 1 October 2026 the per-install Core Technology Fee is replaced by a 5 percent Core Technology Commission on digital transactions in apps distributed outside the App Store, the Initial Acquisition Fee and Store Services Fee are eliminated, apps may offer alternative payment options alongside Apple In-App Purchase, and marketplace and web distribution eligibility widens to seven alternative criteria. Attachment 14 of the ADPLA must be accepted.

deadlines.law: Apple Developer Program License Agreement Attachment 12, Brazil alternative distribution under the CADE decision (Apple Developer news dhwadr2x and umq9wxmm)
deadlines.requirement: By 6 July 2026 all Apple Developer Program members had to accept the updated ADPLA. From iOS 26.5 developers may distribute on alternative marketplaces, operate marketplaces, and process payments for digital goods outside Apple In-App Purchase in Brazil. Unaccepted agreements block new submissions.

deadlines.law: App Store regional age rating changes. Australia 15+ removed, Vietnam Decree 147 Article 38 region-specific rating (Apple Developer news yrrb45pw)
deadlines.requirement: From 18 June 2026 the 15+ rating is no longer available in Australia (affected apps move to 16+), and apps available in Vietnam require a region-specific age rating aligned with Decree 147 Article 38. Review your App Store Connect age rating per storefront.

deadlines.law: Google Play Billing Library deprecation ladder (developer.android.com billing deprecation FAQ)
deadlines.requirement: Play Billing Library 8 becomes the minimum for all published apps by 31 August 2027 (extension to 1 November 2027), and version 9 by 31 August 2028 (extension to 1 November 2028). The 31 August 2026 v8 gate for new submissions carried an extension to 1 November 2026. Already-published lower-version binaries keep transacting until their deadline.

deadlines.law: ADA Title II web and mobile app accessibility, 28 CFR Part 35 Subpart H, Interim Final Rule FR Doc. 2026-07663 (20 April 2026)
deadlines.requirement: A mobile app provided or made available by a state or local government entity serving 50,000 or more people must conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Reaches a commercial developer through the contract or licensing chain. The 2024 date of 24 April 2026 was extended to 26 April 2027.

deadlines.law: ADA Title II web and mobile app accessibility, 28 CFR Part 35 Subpart H, Interim Final Rule FR Doc. 2026-07663
deadlines.requirement: Same WCAG 2.1 AA duty for public entities under 50,000 people and every special district government, extended to 26 April 2028.

deadlines.law: Section 504 web and mobile app accessibility for recipients of HHS financial assistance, 45 CFR 84.84(b), Interim Final Rule 91 FR 25496 (11 May 2026)
deadlines.requirement: A mobile app provided directly or through a contractual or licensing arrangement by any recipient of HHS federal financial assistance with 15 or more employees must conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Extended from 11 May 2026 to 11 May 2027.

deadlines.law: Section 504 web and mobile app accessibility, 45 CFR 84.84(b)(2), Interim Final Rule 91 FR 25496
deadlines.requirement: Same WCAG 2.1 AA duty for HHS-funded recipients with fewer than 15 employees, extended from 10 May 2027 to 10 May 2028.

deadlines.law: FTC Enforcement Policy Statement Promoting the Adoption of Age-Verification Technology under the COPPA Rule (25 February 2026)
deadlines.requirement: A general-audience or mixed-audience app may collect age data for age verification without COPPA enforcement risk only if it uses the data solely for age determination, minimises retention, vets third parties, notices parents and children, and secures the data. In force until final COPPA rule amendments are published or the statement is withdrawn.

deadlines.law: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 section 103 and Schedule 10, commenced by SI 2026/82 regulation 3
deadlines.requirement: Operate a data-protection complaints process. Acknowledge a data subject complaint within 30 days and respond without undue delay.

deadlines.law: ICO final Guidance on Storage and Access Technologies (29 April 2026), PECR regulation 6 with the DUAA Schedule A1 exemptions and the uplifted PECR penalty (17.5 million pounds or 4 percent of turnover)
deadlines.requirement: Re-audit every SDK, tracking pixel, and device-fingerprinting call against the guidance, not only cookies. A consent breach now carries the UK GDPR scale fine.

deadlines.law: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024, Part 4 Chapter 2 subscription contracts regime
deadlines.requirement: Auto-renewing subscription apps sold to UK consumers need pre-contract information, renewal reminders, two cooling-off periods, an easy cancellation path, and the new refund rules. Government announced on 9 August 2026 that the regime commences in January 2027 (exact day not yet published), superseding the earlier spring 2027 estimate.

deadlines.law: Online Safety Act 2023, Ofcom statutory report on the use of app stores by children
deadlines.requirement: Ofcom publishes its report on app stores by January 2027. It feeds the Secretary of State decision on whether app stores are brought into scope of the Online Safety Act. Watch item, no direct developer duty yet.

deadlines.law: Under-16 social media ban and functionality restrictions, secondary legislation under the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Act (announced 15 June 2026)
deadlines.requirement: Regulations are to be laid before the end of 2026 and implemented in spring 2027 (exact day not yet published, tracked here as 1 March 2027). User-to-user social platforms must block under-16 accounts. For 16 and 17 year olds livestreaming and stranger contact are off by default, notifications are off from midnight to 6am, autoplay and personalised feeds are off by default. AI romantic companion chatbots must enforce a minimum age of 18.

deadlines.law: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, Article 111(4) and Article 5(1)(ba) and (bb)
deadlines.requirement: Retrofit Article 50(2) machine-readable AI-content marking onto any generative audio, image, video, or text system already on the market before 2 August 2026, and stop operating any AI system whose intended or reasonably foreseeable output is non-consensual intimate imagery or child sexual abuse material.

deadlines.law: Product Liability Directive (EU) 2024/2853, Articles 21 and 22
deadlines.requirement: From 9 December 2026 national strict-liability law treats standalone software and app updates as a product. Anything placed on the market or put into service on or after that date falls under the new regime.

deadlines.law: Data Act, Regulation (EU) 2023/2854, Article 29(1)
deadlines.requirement: Providers of data processing services charge zero for a customer switching away. Legacy indefinite or long-dated contracts concluded on or before 12 September 2025 must meet Chapter IV unfair-terms rules by 12 September 2027.

deadlines.law: eIDAS 2, Regulation (EU) 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183, Article 5f(2)
deadlines.requirement: A private relying party above micro or small size that uses strong user authentication in banking, finance, health, telecom, transport, energy, education, or digital infrastructure must accept the EU Digital Identity Wallet on user request, 36 months after the implementing acts (derived date 24 December 2027).

deadlines.law: Regulation (EU) 2026/1881 of 24 July 2026, temporary ePrivacy derogation for voluntary CSAM detection
deadlines.requirement: Voluntary CSAM scanning in number-independent interpersonal communications services is lawful only until 3 April 2028. A messaging app relying on it needs the permanent CSA Regulation basis or must stop.

deadlines.law: Personal Information Protection Act amendment, Act No. 21445
deadlines.requirement: Name the CEO and representative as the final accountable parties, seat a board-approved chief privacy officer at qualifying scale, and absorb punitive surcharges plus widened breach notification.

deadlines.law: Interim Measures for AI Anthropomorphic Interactive Services, CAC Order No. 21
deadlines.requirement: Identify minor users, switch them into minors mode automatically, obtain guardian consent under 14, and never offer virtual companion or virtual kin services to a minor. Any chat, companion, or roleplay app shipping in China is in scope.

deadlines.law: Online Safety (Relief and Accountability) Act 2025, partial commencement
deadlines.requirement: Act on notice from the Online Safety Commission as a platform to address the five priority harms. Further harm categories follow progressively with no published date.

deadlines.law: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules 2025, G.S.R. 846(E), rule 4
deadlines.requirement: Registered Consent Managers commence one year after Gazette publication (13 November 2025). Be ready to interoperate with a registered Consent Manager ahead of the 18-month tranche on 13 May 2027.

deadlines.law: Act on the Protection of Personal Information amendment, promulgated 17 July 2026 (Act No. 56 of 2026, number from secondary sources)
deadlines.requirement: Rebuild consent, children's data, and biometric handling for the amended APPI, including a new under-16 threshold where the legal representative is the party for consent, notice, and use-stop requests, plus a surcharge regime. Effective within two years of promulgation, exact day set by cabinet order.

deadlines.law: App Distribution Services Online Safety Code (Class 1C and Class 2 Material), Schedule 7 of the Consolidated Industry Codes, registered 9 September 2025
deadlines.requirement: App stores apply age assurance and access controls before permitting the download or purchase of adult apps, six months after the Code commenced. The Head Terms working-towards grace period ends and the initial risk assessment is due the same day. Read from a Wayback capture of eSafety pages last updated 19 May 2026 because esafety.gov.au was unreachable, re-confirm on the live register.

deadlines.law: Privacy Act 1988 APP 1.7 to 1.9, inserted by the Privacy and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2024
deadlines.requirement: From 10 December 2026 the privacy policy must state the kinds of personal information used by, and the decisions made by, automated decision-making that significantly affects rights or interests.

deadlines.law: Children's Online Privacy Code under the Privacy Act 1988
deadlines.requirement: The Code must be finalised and registered by 10 December 2026, bringing binding children's-privacy obligations to social media, relevant electronic services, and designated internet services.

deadlines.law: Decreto n. 12.880 of 18 March 2026, Articles 21 and 25, regulating the Digital ECA
deadlines.requirement: App stores and operating systems supply a free age signal, request age at account creation, verify it by an ANPD-approved method, allow contestation, seek guardian authorisation, and show the age rating before download. Stores must block gambling and lottery apps and any app lacking an age-verification solution.

deadlines.law: ANPD Digital ECA roadmap, Etapa II and III
deadlines.requirement: ANPD publishes guidance and normative parameters on age-assurance mechanisms from August 2026 with adaptation through November 2026, and starts active enforcement of the Digital ECA age-assurance obligations from January 2027.

deadlines.law: TAKE IT DOWN Act, Pub. L. 119-12
deadlines.requirement: Covered platforms run a clear and conspicuous non-consensual intimate imagery notice-and-removal process and remove reported content, with known identical copies, within 48 hours. FTC enforcement began 19 May 2026.

deadlines.law: AB 1043, Digital Age Assurance Act, Civil Code Title 1.81.9
deadlines.requirement: Operating systems and app stores collect age at setup and expose an age-bracket signal by API. Developers request and use the signal. Operative 1 January 2027.

deadlines.law: SB 976, Protecting Our Kids from Social Media Addiction Act, Health and Safety Code sections 27001 to 27006
deadlines.requirement: From 1 January 2027 treat every user as a minor unless age assurance reasonably determines otherwise before serving an addictive feed or sending notifications between midnight and 6am or during school hours. AG age-assurance regulations due the same day.

deadlines.law: AB 56, Health and Safety Code Chapter 25 from section 28000
deadlines.requirement: Covered social media platforms display the Surgeon General black-box warning daily on first use, again after three cumulative hours, then hourly. Operative 1 January 2027.

deadlines.law: CPPA regulations, 11 CCR section 7200(b), 7155(b), 7157(a)(1), 7121(a)
deadlines.requirement: Give notice, allow opt-out, and answer access requests for automated decision-making technology used in significant decisions by 1 January 2027. Complete risk assessments for pre-2026 processing by 31 December 2027 and submit by 1 April 2028. Cybersecurity audit certifications start 1 April 2028 for revenue above 100 million dollars.

deadlines.law: SB 243, Business and Professions Code Chapter 22.6, sections 22601 to 22606
deadlines.requirement: Companion chatbot operators report annually to the Office of Suicide Prevention on crisis referrals and protocols from 1 July 2027, on top of the disclosure and minor-protection duties already in force.

deadlines.law: Stop Addictive Feeds Exploitation (SAFE) for Kids Act, AG final rules published 29 July 2026
deadlines.requirement: From 25 January 2027 restrict addictive feeds and midnight-to-6am notifications for minors absent verifiable parental consent, using certified age assurance.

deadlines.law: Age-Appropriate Design Code Act, Act 63
deadlines.requirement: Highest-privacy defaults for minors, minimised collection, no late-night push notifications, AG age-assurance rules apply. Effective 1 January 2027. Rulemaking comments due 2 October 2026.

deadlines.law: HB 2225, Chapter 168, Laws of 2026, regulating artificial intelligence companion chatbots
deadlines.requirement: Companion chatbot disclosure and minor protections, including an hourly disclosure for continuing minor use. Effective 1 January 2027.

deadlines.law: SB26-051, Age Attestation on Computing Devices
deadlines.requirement: Operating system providers request age at account setup and expose a real-time age-signal API. Developers request the signal at launch or account creation. Effective 1 July 2028, existing devices by 1 January 2029.

deadlines.law: SB 546, Oklahoma Consumer Data Privacy Act
deadlines.requirement: Honour access, correction, deletion, portability, and opt-out of sale, targeted advertising, and profiling from 1 January 2027.
